answers.core: Being able to detect input properly is extremely fundamental behavior.
answers.workaround:
The only *workaround* I can come up with is to use `is_action_pressed` which follows desired behavior. This only works, though, if your input is not dynamic and can definitely be mapped to an action. e.g.:

```gdscript
func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
    if event is InputEventKey && event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
        print("KEY_ESCAPE")
```

If the input key detection is dynamic, I have no idea of any possible workaround.

title: Windows key held repeat - inconsistency in event.is_pressed
